metadata.gitb:name: [eu.detergent] Validate an uploaded Digital Product Passport
metadata.gitb:description: Upload a passport as JSON-LD and validate it against the "eu.detergent" shapes (EU Detergent — Detergents Regulation 2026/405). The passport's own @context is resolved from ref.openepcis.org, so it must reference the published contexts — the same condition a real consumer of the passport faces.

verify.desc: Validate against the eu.detergent SHACL shapes

failure.default: "The passport does not conform to eu.detergent. The failed step's report lists every violation."
